conventions.bloc_lifecycle: LockdownService activated after startOrResume, deactivated on terminal completion and close()
conventions.widget_pattern: StatelessWidget for dialog (no internal state), StatefulWidget for banner (owns StreamSubscription and Timer)
conventions.string_constants: All user-facing strings in ExamAttemptStrings — no inline literals
conventions.color_constants: All colors in AppColors — no inline Color()

findings.title: _completeAttempt changed from void to Future<void> — caller chain updated
findings.description: The shared terminal teardown _completeAttempt was changed from void to Future<void> so it can await deactivateLockdown(). Both callers (_emitFromResponse and _onForceSubmitRequested) are already async and were updated to await _completeAttempt(...).
findings.required_action: Verify all callers of _completeAttempt are async and await it.
findings.resolution: _emitFromResponse and _onForceSubmitRequested both await _completeAttempt(...). No synchronous callers remain.

findings.title: ViolationWarningBanner owns a StreamSubscription and Timer — both must be cancelled in dispose()
findings.description: ViolationWarningBanner is a StatefulWidget with a StreamSubscription (_subscription) and Timer (_dismissTimer). Both must be cancelled when the widget is disposed.
findings.required_action: Confirm dispose() is present and cancels both resources.
findings.resolution: dispose() correctly cancels _subscription and _dismissTimer before super.dispose().
references: CODING_STANDARDS_APP.md: dispose() all controllers and subscriptions

findings.title: close() teardown uses unawaited for deactivateLockdown() — errors silently swallowed
findings.description: ExamAttemptBloc.close() calls unawaited(_lockdownService.deactivateLockdown()). This is intentional: blocking close() on platform IO (hook uninstallation) would extend disposal unpredictably. The design accepts that teardown errors are silently dropped at this level.
findings.required_action: ADVISORY: Document this in a comment so future maintainers know not to add 'await' here.
findings.resolution: Comment added: 'Best-effort: if the bloc is being torn down while a lockdown session is still active (force-quit, hot-restart, etc.) we want the window back to a normal state. Errors are silently ignored because there's no UI to surface them on at this point.'

findings.title: AttemptTaskResponse.lockdownMode is nullable — null treated as LockdownMode.none
findings.description: The backend's AttemptTaskResponse carries lockdownMode as a nullable String. If the backend hasn't been deployed with Phase 1, the field is absent and null. The bloc's _activateLockdownForResponse treats null as none, so a pre-Phase-1 backend causes no lockdown rather than crashing.
findings.required_action: ADVISORY: Backend Phase 1 must be deployed before this app version ships. The null-safe default is correct defensive behavior.

findings.title: ViolationWarningBanner receives LockdownService.violations stream from context.read — stream lives across the whole app
findings.description: The ViolationWarningBanner in ExamScaffold reads the LockdownService from context.read<LockdownService>().violations. This is a broadcast stream that outlives the exam attempt. The banner only renders when _current is non-null, so showing nothing before the first violation is correct.
findings.required_action: None — the broadcast stream is safe to hold across app lifecycle. The banner's own subscription lifecycle is scoped to the widget.

findings.title: Verification gates (build, test, analyze) could not run — toolchain unavailable
findings.description: Flutter, Dart, CMake, and MSVC are not present in PATH. The flutter test and flutter analyze commands could not be executed. All findings above are from static review only.
findings.required_action: Gate commands must be run manually in a Windows environment with the full Flutter toolchain installed.

verdict_reason: 3 MEDIUM findings resolved (async teardown chain, stream disposal, close() semantics documented). 3 NOTED findings (null-safe lockdownMode, broadcast stream lifetime, toolchain). Phase 05 code is structurally sound for UI integration.
